captureRule: At age-threshold emission bind subject person ID before/after, preserve birthYear, require before age<14 and after age>=14 at event years. Both motherId and fatherId must be distinct nonempty IDs and each resolve exactly once across after.persons.people and after.persons.past with explicit alive and nonempty householdId. Subject must belong to current people, alive=true, leftYear absent. A co-resident parent must belong to current people AND alive=true AND leftYear absent AND householdId equal subject; only then co_resident. A living parent in past, or any parent with leftYear, never qualifies even when historical householdId is equal. If both parents resolve but neither qualifies -> not_co_resident. Unknown/missing parent IDs -> unknown, never absent. No orphanhood, death cause, care quality or work start inferred; current ages/parents never backfill.
reconstruction: Unknown for old records without this verified event-time snapshot. Never fill from current persons, estates or office holders.
